unit: The USA 1945-1974: The People and the State
title: McCarthyism

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of McCarthyism — how Senator McCarthy made Communist subversion the dominant political fear of 1950-54.

items.title: What is McCarthyism? And how did it happen? — Ellen Schrecker
items.description: TED-Ed animation on how McCarthy exploited fear of Communism and eventually overreached. 5 min.

items.title: "Have You No Decency?" | McCarthy | American Experience | PBS
items.description: PBS clip of the Army-McCarthy hearings — the moment lawyer Joseph Welch dismantled McCarthy on live television.

items.title: Good Night, and Good Luck (2005)
items.description: Ed Murrow's televised challenge to McCarthy — the best dramatisation of how McCarthyism fell apart. Shot in period black and white.

items.title: The Manchurian Candidate (1962)
items.description: Cold War paranoia thriller — captures the atmosphere of McCarthyite suspicion and fear of Communist infiltration.

items.title: PBS American Experience — McCarthy
items.description: PBS resources on McCarthyism including documentary clips, primary sources and timeline.
